---
title: "5.2_build_binary_patch_rasters_zonation_feature_list"
output: html_document
params:
  patch_raster_dir: "Data/Clean/Patches"
  binary_patch_raster_dir: "Data/Clean/Patches_binary"
  zonation_parent_dir: "Data/Clean/ZonationOutputs"
  benchmark_rank_map_dir: "Data/Clean/ZonationOutputs/benchmark_rank_maps"
  overwrite: true
---

```{r setup, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = FALSE)
}

if (!requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The 'terra' package is required.")
}

patch_raster_dir <- params$patch_raster_dir
binary_patch_raster_dir <- params$binary_patch_raster_dir
zonation_parent_dir <- params$zonation_parent_dir
benchmark_rank_map_dir <- params$benchmark_rank_map_dir
feature_list_path <- file.path(
  zonation_parent_dir,
  "zonation_binary_patch_feature_list.txt"
)
zonation_modes <- c("ABF", "CAZ1", "CAZ2", "CAZMAX")
zonation_output_dirs <- file.path(zonation_parent_dir, zonation_modes)
names(zonation_output_dirs) <- tolower(zonation_modes)
overwrite_outputs <- isTRUE(params$overwrite)

if (!dir.exists(patch_raster_dir)) {
  stop("Missing patch raster directory: ", patch_raster_dir)
}

dir.create(binary_patch_raster_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(zonation_parent_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(benchmark_rank_map_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
invisible(vapply(
  zonation_output_dirs,
  dir.create,
  logical(1L),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
))

patch_raster_paths <- list.files(
  patch_raster_dir,
  pattern = "\\.tif$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (!length(patch_raster_paths)) {
  stop("No .tif patch rasters found in: ", patch_raster_dir)
}

patch_raster_paths <- sort(patch_raster_paths)
```

```{r build_binary_rasters}
binary_raster_paths <- vapply(
  patch_raster_paths,
  function(input_path) {
    output_path <- file.path(
      binary_patch_raster_dir,
      basename(input_path)
    )

    patch_raster <- terra::rast(input_path)
    binary_raster <- terra::ifel(is.na(patch_raster), NA, 1)
    names(binary_raster) <- names(patch_raster)

    terra::writeRaster(
      binary_raster,
      filename = output_path,
      overwrite = overwrite_outputs,
      datatype = "INT2S",
      NAflag = -32768
    )

    output_path
  },
  character(1L)
)
```

```{r write_feature_list}
feature_list <- data.frame(
  weight = rep(1, length(binary_raster_paths)),
  filename = normalizePath(binary_raster_paths, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

writeLines(
  c(
    '"weight" "filename"',
    sprintf(
      "%s %s",
      format(feature_list$weight, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
      shQuote(feature_list$filename, type = "cmd")
    )
  ),
  con = feature_list_path
)

message("Wrote ", length(binary_raster_paths), " binary patch raster(s) to: ", binary_patch_raster_dir)
message("Wrote Zonation feature list to: ", feature_list_path)
message("Created Zonation output directories under: ", zonation_parent_dir)
```

```{r copy_zonation_rankmaps_to_benchmark}
zonation_rankmap_table <- data.frame(
  mode = names(zonation_output_dirs),
  source = file.path(unname(zonation_output_dirs), "rankmap.tif"),
  target = file.path(
    benchmark_rank_map_dir,
    paste0("rankmap_", names(zonation_output_dirs), ".tif")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rankmap_exists <- file.exists(zonation_rankmap_table$source)

copied_rankmaps <- if (any(rankmap_exists)) {
  file.copy(
    from = zonation_rankmap_table$source[rankmap_exists],
    to = zonation_rankmap_table$target[rankmap_exists],
    overwrite = overwrite_outputs
  )
} else {
  logical(0L)
}

if (any(!rankmap_exists)) {
  message(
    "Skipping missing Zonation rankmap(s): ",
    paste(zonation_rankmap_table$mode[!rankmap_exists], collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(copied_rankmaps)) {
  copied_modes <- zonation_rankmap_table$mode[rankmap_exists][copied_rankmaps]
  message(
    "Copied Zonation rankmap(s) to benchmark directory: ",
    paste(copied_modes, collapse = ", ")
  )
} else {
  message("No Zonation rankmap.tif files were available to copy.")
}
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
cat("\nBinary patch raster summary\n")
cat("===========================\n")
cat("Input patch raster directory: ", patch_raster_dir, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Binary patch raster directory: ", binary_patch_raster_dir, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Zonation parent directory: ", zonation_parent_dir, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Feature list: ", feature_list_path, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Zonation output directories:\n")
cat(paste0("  - ", zonation_output_dirs, collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Benchmark rank map directory: ", benchmark_rank_map_dir, "\n", sep = "")
if (exists("zonation_rankmap_table")) {
  cat("Benchmark rank map targets:\n")
  cat(paste0("  - ", zonation_rankmap_table$target, collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("Rasters processed: ", length(binary_raster_paths), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Feature weight: 1 for every raster\n")
```
